title: Gretest “alarm”
body: Once you load a reminder, rest assured you wont miss whatever you logged for reminder. i love the fact that you can even set early reminder  warning. I have grown to just log everything that needs reminding. And best of all, you can set reminder months ahead and you will for sure be reminded!
author: Mrosizana

title: Productive
body: Good app, helps me stay on track.
author: cyril_dipz

title: Reminder app
body: I love this app, I use it everyday to set my important tasks and it is easy to check the tasks completed by just a click also if you forget to check your reminder you will be reminded of it
author: Not Berman
